reviews.review_description: We really appreciated your SolarQuotes website and referred to it regularly for general info on Solar (as we knew lIittle) as well as info on performance and quality of solar panels and inverters and ratings for solar installers. As far as the quotes you arranged for us, we really liked Solar Wide as they came out and gave us lots of time and advice, no strings attached. It was only that we could get a bigger system in the brand we eventually decided we wanted for a discounted price through Lifestyle. They were also a well rated company who had been around for a decent amount of time. Thank you so much for making our Solar experience so much smoother by providing such a comprehensive run down online.

I did significant research on the product/brand i wanted and then got it down to 3 suppliers (one was from your list) that could supply the product i wanted and i thought were capable and likely to be around a whileI then confirmed up prices ensuring "apples for apples" from those suppliers and chose one (they also were the cheapest)The company that i chose certainly knew their stuff and the installation was prompt and done very capablyThus far i am a very happy customer
